test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is 'who.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "***I was walking home from work when I saw someone ___(1)___ I thought was my friend Sandra***'' is indicating identifying someone like my friend Sandra.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'who'.
 
• The word 'who' is used **for saying exactly which person or what kind of person you are talking about**. 
 
 
• Example:* Dhoni is not someone **who** accepts failure easily*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete Sentence: *I was walking home from work when I saw someone **who** I thought was my friend Sandra**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'Such' is used **for referring to somebody or something that you mentioned earlier of this or that type**. (पूर्व निर्दिष्ट व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का संकेत करने के लिए प्रयुक्त, ऐसा, वैसा)
 
• 'Which' is used **for saying exactly what thing or things you are talking about**. (जो; जो कि, बिल्‍कुल सही वस्‍तु या वस्‍तुओं का निर्देश करने के लिए प्रयुक्त)
 
• 'How' means **in what way**. (किस प्रकार, कैसे)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*I was walking home from work when I saw someone ___(1)___ I thought was my friend Sandra*'' मेरे दोस्त सैंड्रा जैसे किसी व्यक्ति की पहचान करने का संकेत दे रहा है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'who' है।
 
• '**Who**' शब्द का प्रयोग यह कहने के लिए किया जाता है कि **आप किस व्यक्ति या किस प्रकार के व्यक्ति के बारे में बात कर रहे हैं**।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *Dhoni is not someone who accepts failure easily*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *I was walking home from work when I saw someone who I thought was my friend Sandra**.*
